records.trigger_summary: ARISE, the association of India's private K-12 schools, appointed a category-exclusive learning partner for its member network, showing it runs a structured partner programme and could be a channel to its 1,800+ member schools for a school-platform category such as ScholarClone.
records.what_happened: Burlington English India became ARISE's category-exclusive English language learning and communication skills partner. The ARISE network covers more than 1,800 schools in 20 states and union territories, about 1.5 million students and 85,000 educators.
records.source_title: Burlington English India Partners With ARISE To Expand English Learning Across K-12 Schools
records.source_excerpt: Burlington English India becomes ARISE's category-exclusive English language learning and communication skills partner.
records.likely_problem: Needs differentiated partner offerings for member schools beyond content.
records.what_we_could_sell: Scholar One / Scholar Learn / Scholar Insight as an ARISE-endorsed platform category for member schools, via an association partnership.

scores.reasoning: Real, dated partner appointment by a large school network, but it is a syndicated press release and the English-learning category is not ours, so the channel fit is inferred.

records.trigger_summary: School-chain franchisor Lighthouse Learning added Meru International School, Hyderabad, to its partner school network, offering shared central academic and digital services, so it could bundle a school platform across its network.
records.what_happened: Lighthouse Learning announced a strategic partnership with Meru International School, Hyderabad, giving it access to Lighthouse's central education team, safety framework, well-being centre, in-house digital labs and national network.
records.source_title: Lighthouse Learning expands Hyderabad footprint with strategic partnership with Meru International School
records.source_excerpt: We are delighted to welcome Meru to the Lighthouse Learning family.
records.likely_problem: Needs consistent operations and digital tooling across a growing partner-school network.
records.what_we_could_sell: Scholar Core and Scholar Insight for operations and leadership visibility across network schools; Scholar CCB for staff capability.

scores.reasoning: Dated network expansion by a national school group; the page does not say they seek a platform partner, and the release is a syndicated Business Wire item.

records.trigger_summary: Navneet, a curriculum and content provider, announced a push to grow its CBSE business 30% year on year across a base of 40,000+ schools, making it a possible content-plus-platform channel into schools.
records.what_happened: Navneet Education was named CBSE Publisher of the Year for a third year, added 10 new CBSE titles including AI handbooks, and states its resources reach 40,000+ schools in India.
records.source_title: Navneet Education expands its CBSE portfolio, accelerates AI innovation in classroom education
records.source_excerpt: Today, Navneet's educational resources reach 10 million+ students and 2 lakh+ teachers across 40,000+ schools in India
records.likely_problem: Wants to deepen school relationships beyond textbooks with AI and digital offerings.
records.what_we_could_sell: Scholar Learn and Scholar Compass as a co-sold platform layer alongside Navneet content and its teacher AI training.

scores.reasoning: Dated growth announcement with a very large school footprint; Navneet has its own edtech products so an overlap check is needed, and the page does not mention seeking partners.
